message.skyabyss.tide.leaving: Beyond the tide gate, you hear the sea of the world below.

title.skyabyss.tide_back.sub: Atop the shell of the titan that walks the sea

subtitles.skyabyss.tide_heart_beat: A heart beats deep in the shell
subtitles.skyabyss.tide_heart_death: The heart stops; the shell crumbles
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.begin: The entrance is sealed. Deep in the spiral shell, the heart of the tide shell begins to beat
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.asleep: The heart sleeps deeply (it does not wake on Peaceful)
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.descend: The floor sinks and you reach the dry bottom of the shell. From within comes a beat like the ebb and flow of the tide.
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.exit_hint: Step on the glowing floor at the south end of the antechamber to return to the island
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.pillar: The pillar of light carried you to the tide gate beach
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.defeated: The heart of the tide shell has stopped. On the sea floor, the titan breathes out slowly
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.go: You are in the antechamber of the shell's bottom (the heart lies beyond the north entrance)
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.choice_later: The first-clear gift (one exclusive legendary) can be chosen with /titanmemory tide once those items exist
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.tide_heart_stille:
The spiral shell came undone, and the thin coil that was left fell quiet beneath a silver crescent.

For the first time, I heard a tide that neither rose nor fell.

The titan does not stop. Only, the second fragment pulls, faintly, toward the first.
message.skyabyss.tide_heart.reward: What the heart of the tide shell left behind is now in your hands
item.skyabyss.tide_pearl.desc: Taken from the great clam. Set it on the chime stone at the altar
item.skyabyss.tide_pearl.desc2: If your head goes under water, the tide pulls it back to the clam
subtitles.skyabyss.tide_horn_low: A low tide horn (the tide is coming in)
subtitles.skyabyss.tide_horn_high: A high tide horn (the tide is going out)
subtitles.skyabyss.tide_pearl_return: The tide pulls the pearl away
message.skyabyss.tide.rising_soon: A low horn sounds across the island. The tide will rise soon
message.skyabyss.tide.falling_soon: A high horn. The tide will fall soon
message.skyabyss.tide.stone_ringing: A chime stone begins to ring: %s (%s / %s)
message.skyabyss.tide.all_rung: The three chime stones ring together. The water of the Tide Hall drains away below...
message.skyabyss.tide.bottom_opened: The grate in the hall floor has sunk. A spiral stair leads down to the tide's bottom
message.skyabyss.tide.return_opened: A floor nearby lights up. A way back to the Tide Hall has opened
message.skyabyss.tide.return_path: The tideway carried you back near the hall
message.skyabyss.tide.trials_renewed: The tide shell's heart beats again, a beat returning from beneath the seabed. The trials on its back are as they were
message.skyabyss.tide.gave_up: You hold your hand to the blue fire, and the sound of the tide fades. You are back at the Tidegate Beach
message.skyabyss.tide.campfire_hint: Crouch and touch the campfire to give up the trial and return to the Tidegate Beach
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_taken: The great clam opens and gives up the tide pearl. It is heavy. If your head goes under, the tide will come for it
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_full: Your inventory is full; you cannot take the pearl
message.skyabyss.tide.altar_hint: Hold the tide pearl and touch the stone
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_pulled: The tide pulled the pearl away (it is back in the clam)
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_dropped: The tide took the pearl from the sand (it is back in the clam)
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_left_garden: Away from the garden, the tide pulled the pearl back to the clam
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_fallen: The pearl slipped from a fallen hand and returned to the clam
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_lost: The pearl's presence is gone. It seems to be back in the clam
message.skyabyss.tide.reset_plug: You pulled the return plug. The three basins sink back to where they began
message.skyabyss.tide.reset_plug_wait: The return plug is still heavy (%s s)
message.skyabyss.tide.door_blocked: Someone stands in a basin door. The water waits
message.skyabyss.tide.nest_closed: The nest has shut its shell (only half the damage gets through while the tide is in; at ebb its mouth opens)
message.skyabyss.tide.nests_all_broken: The last nest crumbles. Under the sand, something moves its legs...
message.skyabyss.tide.beckoner_gathering: The flats' mouth will close. Gather on the flats within %s s
message.skyabyss.tide.beckoner_begin: The sand splits. The Tide Beckoner rises
message.skyabyss.tide.beckoner_sank: The Tide Beckoner sank into the sand. The flats' mouth opens
message.skyabyss.tide.beckoner_defeated: The Tide Beckoner's great claw falls to the sand
message.skyabyss.tide.front_stone_ready: The chime stone at the end of the flats waits to be touched
message.skyabyss.tide.front_silent: The stone is silent. The tide's keeper is still on the flats
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.tide_shell.title: The Moving Island
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.tide_shell.body:
Off the coast lay a low island grown with coral. The next day, seen from the same beach, it had shifted a little to the right.

On the third day it was gone.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.tide_ruins.title: Ruins of the Tide People
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.tide_ruins.body:
Stone steps and basins remained on the shell. Every basin bore a thin line, cut at the same height.

No one was there. Among the garden's coral stood statue after statue, each still gripping a harpoon.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_tide_:
On a pillar by the tidegate. It seems meant for those who cross.

The stone was dry, yet cold to the touch.
Cut into the ledge under the moon window. Along the basin's rim the stone is worn smooth in places, as if people sat there waiting.

On the wall behind the stone where the pearl is set.

The great clam gives up its pearl again and again. It is always the tide that comes to take it back.
On the ledge overlooking the three basins. Only the last line is cut deeper than the rest.
A fallen tablet on a rock in the flats. The tide has worn its letters round.
At the foot of the spiral, on the wall of the small room with the campfire. It is the only inscription written as a question.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.beckoner.title: The Tide Beckoner
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.beckoner.body: Even after the great claw fell to the sand, the tide kept rising for a while. It was as if the tide had not noticed that the one who called it was gone.
commands.skyabyss.tideback.reset: Reset the tide back trials (sleeping trial: %s)

commands.skyabyss.tideback.rooms: Room owners: garden %s / tidewatch %s / flats %s / shell bottom %s (your group %s)
commands.skyabyss.tideback.not_built: The tide back is not built yet (/skyabyss titan board tide)
message.skyabyss.whisper.tide_landing: You stand on the titan's flipper. The great gate in the shell's flank leads inside
message.skyabyss.whisper.tide_beach: The shell gauge at the top right shows the tide. Ring the three stones (west, east, front) to open the tide floor of the hall. The stairs in the west wall climb onto the shell
message.skyabyss.whisper.tide_hub: Ring the stones in any order. At flood, swim the basin; at ebb, walk. Either way you can reach the east gallery and the north gate to the flats. The gate is always open
message.skyabyss.whisper.tide_top: You are out on the shell. Walk down to its front rim to see the titan's neck and head rising from the sea
message.skyabyss.whisper.tide_garden: Carry the giant clam's pearl to the north altar. Climb a platform before the tide comes in; if the tide covers your head, the pearl returns to the clam
message.skyabyss.whisper.tide_watch: A plug stand's stone is where the water comes from; the rug in front is where it goes. Water moves to the basin whose pillars match. A door opens when its basin holds 1 level or less; a float that reaches the lights lifts you a tier. The weight plate reverses the plug with the same mark beside it
message.skyabyss.whisper.tide_flats: At ebb the nests open their mouths and spill scuttlers; at flood they shut their shells and take half damage. You can break them either way. When the tide comes in, climb the rocks or dive and crack them
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.west.take: Take the pearl from the clam. The altar is far to the north
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.west.carry: Carry it north to the altar. Climb a plinth at flood. Keep your head dry
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.west.place: Touch the altar stone to set the pearl
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.west.help: An ally carries the pearl. Clear the way
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.west.done: The west stone rang. Take the glowing floor back to the hall
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.east.go: Plugs move water. Rise on a float to the lights, then empty the top basin
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.east.exit: The bottom door is open. Touch the stone on the ledge
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.east.done: The east stone rang. Take the glowing floor back to the hall
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.front.nests: Break the nests (%1$s / %3$s). Ebb: swarm. Flood: half damage
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.front.boss: All nests down. Defeat the Tidecaller; it rises from the sand even at flood
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.front.stone: The Tidecaller fell. Touch the stone at the far end
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.front.done: The north stone rang. Take the glowing floor back to the hall
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.hub.stones: Ring the three stones (%1$s / 3). Rising, swim up; falling, walk forth
gui.skyabyss.tide_goal.hub.bottom: The grate in the floor sank. Spiral down to the depths
message.skyabyss.tide.plug_on: Plug pulled. Water moves from the %s to the %s
message.skyabyss.tide.plug_off: Plug reset. Water stops from the %s to the %s
message.skyabyss.tide.plate_down: The plate sank. The marked plug now flows backward (%s to %s)
message.skyabyss.tide.plate_up: The plate rose. The flow returns to normal
message.skyabyss.tide.float_reached: The %s float reached the lights. You can climb to the next tier
message.skyabyss.tide.door_opened: The door opened. Step onto the float
message.skyabyss.tide.exit_opened: The bottom door opened. Go to the stone on the ledge
message.skyabyss.tide.door_shut: The door of the %s is shut. Lower it to 1 level or less (now %s)
message.skyabyss.tide.exit_shut: The bottom door is shut. Empty the top basin (now %2$s)
message.skyabyss.tide.pearl_halfway: The pearl is past the garden's midpoint. The altar lies ahead, far north
message.skyabyss.tide.boat_given: The shore is far, so a boat was set out for you
message.skyabyss.tide.quiet_west: Tonight the western Coral Garden is quiet (fewer coral thralls; no channel scuttlers or bubble puffers)
message.skyabyss.tide.quiet_east: Tonight the eastern Tidewatch Hall is quiet (no bubble puffers, and the gentlest plug layout)
message.skyabyss.tide.quiet_front: Tonight the front Swarm Flats are quiet (fewer scuttlers, no bubble puffers)
